text:
priya: Heads up — hosted GPU consumption is ~27% above our committed forecast this week for US regions. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/committed-vs-usage
leo: Can you drop the quick numbers here?
priya: Committed=4800 GPU-hrs, Actual hosted=6100 GPU-hrs, delta=+1300h (27%). Top offender appears to be embed-bulk (/tenant-42) in us-west-2.
sana: Billing export looks weird — some us-west usage is tagged as `prod-us` while our reservation is under `us-central`. Suspect tag mapping or export pipeline bug.
infra-bot: [alert] reserved-utilization-drop >= 20% | region=us-west-2 | detected=2026-06-25T14:11Z | id=alert-8342
mike: Is this tied to Thursday's client surge or a config change?
leo: No client rollout recorded. I see a recent config change to `routing.policy` that may have favored latency over reservation-binding: `routing.policy: prefer-latency-regional` — that could route embed-bulk into us-west instead of the committed pool.
priya: Quick query I ran: `select region, job, sum(gpu_hours) from usage where service='embed-bulk' and ts>now()-7d group by region, job;` -> shows 68% of embed-bulk landed in us-west-2 last 72h.
emma: Suggested immediate actions:
- priya: confirm billing tag mapping and export rows for last 7 days
- leo: add temporary routing override to steer embed-bulk to us-central-1 (weighting)
- sana: open support case with cloud for reservation-tag reconciliation and ask about retro mapping of usage to reservation
priya: :thumbsup: exporting billing CSV now, attaching top-level snippet:
```
region,committed_hours,actual_hours
us-west-2,1200,2400
us-central-1,2000,2100
eu-west-1,1600,1600
```
mike: If us-west stays at this burn rate we'll exceed reservations and hit on-demand spend ~ $48k next week (rough estimate). Need fast mitigation.
leo: I'll push a routing change in ~10m to set embed-bulk preference to us-central (quick config: `routes.embed-bulk.weighting = {us-central-1:0.7, us-west-2:0.3}`). Will monitor.
sana: Filing cloud ticket now, ref CASE-4582, asking for reconciliation and whether reservations can be remapped retroactively.
priya: Created runbook checklist and an internal task in ops board. Looping in finance for potential credit/rebill if cloud supports it.
infra-bot: Action created: incident-8342 reserved-usage-variance | assignee=leo | severity=medium
leo: Pushed routing override, monitoring traffic shift. Will report delta in 15m. :eyes:
priya: Thanks — post any error spikes here. If tagging export still shows mismatch after 2 hours we'll escalate to infra-sre.
mike: Noted. I'll prepare a quick cost sketch for finance if we need to cover on-demand overage.
priya: Update 15m: embed-bulk us-west traffic down 62%, committed-utilization trending back up. Continuing to monitor.
leo: Follow-up: will keep override for 24h and then run a controlled rollout to fix routing policy at source.
sana: Case submitted, awaiting cloud response (ETA 48h).
priya: Closing loop for now — will file a postmortem if billing reconciliation requires finance adjustments.
